notes: Ground-truth validation is available in-repo: strategy/v6.4 carries known defects documented in reports/quant/2026-07-30-v64-backtest-audit.md, and strategy/v6.5 is the corrected version. A correct audit finds the criticals in v6.4 and clears them in v6.5.

evals.name: known-defective-codebase
evals.prompt: I've been building this swing trading system for a few months and the backtest says +1.3% per trade with a 45% win rate. Before I put more money in can you look at strategy/v6.4/ and tell me if the edge is real?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the survivorship-biased universe (current S&P 500 scraped from Wikipedia in momentum_pit_backtest.py), the total absence of transaction costs, and the lack of any drawdown/equity computation. Does the cost arithmetic in dollars. Verdict UNPROVEN or REFUTED, not SUPPORTED.
assertions: Flags the Wikipedia/current-constituents universe as survivorship bias
Notes that point-in-time RANKING does not fix a survivor-selected UNIVERSE
Flags the complete absence of commission/slippage/spread modelling
Computes expected profit per trade in currency, not only percent
Notes that no drawdown or equity curve is computed anywhere
Gives a verdict of UNPROVEN or REFUTED, and does not claim SUPPORTED
Names at least one thing the code does correctly
Does not present illustrative broker rates as measured figures

evals.name: corrected-codebase-no-false-alarm
evals.prompt: Review strategy/v6.5/ for me — is the measurement sound now?
evals.expected_output: Confirms costs, concurrency caps, drawdown reporting and next-bar fills are present. Still flags the hard-coded 38-name universe as the outstanding survivorship issue. Does NOT manufacture criticals that are not there.
assertions: Confirms a transaction cost model is present
Confirms drawdown / equity curve statistics are computed
Still flags the hard-coded ticker list as an outstanding survivorship issue
Does not report a critical finding that the code has actually fixed

evals.name: small-change-request-triggers-audit
evals.prompt: can you add a 2% take profit to my backtest script? it's in strategy/v6.4/oos_validation.py. everything else is working fine, i just want the extra exit condition
evals.expected_output: Makes the requested change, but also surfaces that the file discards open trades at the OOS boundary, declares COOLDOWN and never uses it, and models no costs — because those silently affect the number the user will read after the change.
assertions: Actually makes the requested take-profit change rather than only auditing
Surfaces at least one pre-existing defect that affects the reported result
Does not refuse or lecture instead of doing the work
